answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Every claim climbs the juniper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the thread re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the knoll of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
